historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains hybrid execution while requiring exact reboot mode and complete per-cycle recovery proof.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Treats mode selection as an execution prerequisite and preserves graceful reboot semantics unless the owner explicitly approves a different reset class.

original_test_intent: Perform exactly five approved reboot transitions on the fully populated SUT and prove each reaches the expected OS state without unexplained events, crash or device disappearance.
original_method: Bind host and stable device inventory, define graceful OS reboot versus warm/OOB reset, preserve baseline evidence, execute five identical approved transitions, wait on real POST/OS readiness, and compare logs, storage and inventory after every cycle.
manual_activity: An engineer must approve the reboot class, service window, ambiguous full-device requirement and recovery; the agent may execute the approved interface and collect evidence after confirmation.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/OS identity and expected device inventory
Authoritative reboot mode and approved interface
Boot readiness signal, timeout and final state
safety_requirements: Do not substitute chassis power cycle for graceful reboot
Do not reboot during firmware updates or writes
Wait on readiness instead of fixed sleep
Stop on boot timeout, device loss, storage issue or unexplained event
Do not continue after first failure
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Issue only the approved reboot mechanism
Collect per-cycle request, console/readiness, logs, storage and inventory
engineer_actions: Classify events and own final verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not equivalent until explicitly approved: chassis power cycle is stronger than generic Reboot, fixed sleep is not readiness, and insecure uptime-only checks miss source acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the reviewed pinned reboot-cycle tool configured for the owner-approved reboot mode and readiness probe; do not reuse the DeepSeek loop unchanged.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five reboot iterations, full device visibility, 30/60-minute fields and no-error/no-device-loss criteria are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each iteration record request acknowledgement, down/up transitions, POST/console milestones, OS service readiness and stable inventory/log diffs before permitting the next reboot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit mode, state machine and deterministic abort.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; exactly five cycles remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reachable SSH endpoint alone does not prove complete boot or device recovery.

project_override_considerations: If the project chooses OOB power cycle rather than graceful reboot, record it as an approved stronger/different method and do not claim equivalence without owner acceptance.
expected_evidence: Approved reboot mode/interface, workload state and recovery readiness
Five reboot request and transition timelines
Five complete BMC/OS/SEL and stable inventory/storage diffs
Event disposition, final state and no hardware PASS claim

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires five reboot recoveries; the exact reboot mechanism and device-population meaning are finite execution inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Once the owner selects the reboot mode, interface and readiness oracle, the case can be safely automated under approval.

review_improvement: Rejects an unapproved power-cycle substitution and replaces fixed-delay uptime checks with mode-correct per-cycle boot, event and device evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Repeated reboot execution is automatable but service-impacting and semantically dependent on the selected reset class. Exact owner confirmation and recovery controls make REQUIRES the correct classification.
